LifelinesFor Gaza's displaced families
Gaza · Humanitarian Appeal

A lifeline for families who have lost so much.

Families in displacement camps need food, clean water and shelter. Together, we can help meet essential needs.

Support via WhatsAppRead our appeal
Our appeal

Help keep a lifeline open for Gaza

In Gaza, families are not asking for a better life — just the basics of life: food, water and shelter.

Behind every tent is a family that lost its home, and behind every empty plate is a child waiting.

A contribution can help provide a meal for a family, clean water for a child, or essential support for people who have lost almost everything.

We cannot take away their pain, but together we can help make sure they do not face it alone.

Where support is needed
